_readme: Draft Order Games: the commissioner makes the league compete for draft order every year. Fill in one entry per year (years with an empty 'competition' are hidden on the page): 'competition' (short name), 'description' (how it was played), 'winner' (a manager id from data/managers.json, e.g. 'ryan-nussdorfer', or null) and optional 'notes'. The actual draft order is pulled automatically from the ESPN/Sleeper draft data; don't type it here. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/build_all.py. Optional 'video': {src, poster, type, width, height, caption} plays inline on the year's card (poster sized like the Lore photos); files live in src/static/media/draft-order/.

2022.description: The year the Commissioner turned the draft order into an event. Showing up wasn't enough: theatrics were encouraged and flair was rewarded, robes included.

2023.description: Dress to the nines like you're walking into the arena for Game 7.

2024.description: Cook your best steak and film the tutorial.

2025.description: No judges and no theatrics, just reflexes. The first to text back in the group chat got the pick. It wasn't a test of fantasy knowledge, it was a test of who can't put his phone down.

2026.description: One phone call, no warning, and 60 seconds to write down every NFL player you can think of. Any name someone else also wrote got crossed off, so only the unique names scored.
